notes.title: Patch 24 Released 7/8/2025
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, it's been a while! I hope you enjoy this new update I have been working on for the past few months!



This update several new spell upgrades and improves the UI.



New Features:


Added Spell Upgrades: Stormbond, Death Bloom, Pulse Chain, Comet Skull, Black Hole Collapse, Frozen Soul, Shard Storm, Hydraulic Slam, Focus Lense, MachNeedles, ReflexShot, Needle Hive, Combo Trigger. 

Added Passive Upgrades: Overchannel, Flow State, Dark Rhythm, Hexed Focus, Mirror Curse, Waning Life, Stained SpellBook.


Changes:


Improved the UI for the inventory panel, and spell stats panel.

You can now hold 2 equipment at a time, on either Q or R slots. 

Bug Fixes:


Fixed multiple bugs.

notes.title: Patch 23 Released 3/9/2025
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, it's been a while! I hope you enjoy this new update I have been working on for the past few months!

This is a large update that improves the boss fights, level artwork, and game feel.

New Features:

 Updated all boss fights with new character models, animations, and combat mechanics.
 Updated level artwork for the Desert and Snow environments.

Changes:

 Improved level loading and screen fade transitions.
 Added hit stop effect when the player is struck by melee attacks.

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed multiple bugs.

Happy to announce an update that brings a new hand painted textured style to the level environments! Hope you all like it.

Patch 21 Released 06/15/2024
New Features:

 Improved level artwork with new textures.

Changes:

 AOE spells now trigger damage based on sfx animation timing rather than instantly.

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed bug where the player footsteps play more frequently then they should.

notes.title: Patch 20.2 Released 04/20/2024
notes.notes:
New Features:

 Added a new 'Cat' Quest.
 Added save files to retain meta-game variables and progress.
 Improved controller support for menu navigation.

notes.title: Patch 20.1 Released 03/28/2024
notes.notes:
New Features:

 Added Diminishing Returns for Freeze and GravityPull to reduce cheesing of enemies and bosses.
 Added unique encounter with a shadow version of your player that appears after attempting another run.

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed bug where music triggers and combat zones in the Luminar Hold were not deactivating properly.

notes.title: Patch 20. Released 02/28/2024
notes.notes:
New Features:

 Added new shadow enemies.
 Added target lock on.
 Improved Gamepad Controller support.
 Added Burn, Jolt, and Infection status effects.
 Added several new upgrades.
 Improved graphics and animation quality.
 Added Secret Rooms.

Changes:

 Added backpack displaying current spell and remaining spell power.

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed numerous bugs, and hopefully did not introduce new ones!

notes.title: Patch 14. Released 02/22/2023
notes.notes:
New Features:

 Upon death, you turn into a spectating ghost while there is at least 1 other player alive.
 Doors locked until room mobs are defeated now show a visual hint when the player is nearby.


Changes:

 Enemies now have colliders and you can no longer walk directly through them.
 Player names now default to a random fantasy name.
 Game now starts in fullscreen when launched.


Bug Fixes:

 The upgrade existing spells menu now only shows upgrades for spells your player has learned.
 Removed LightStone from possible equipment pickups, now that it is a consumable item pickup to avoid duplicate items in the loadout.
 Player action input is now blocked while focusing in a text input field.
 Spell exhaust is reset on all clients after leaving the start room instead of just the host.
 Fixed bug where Light Stone ability would stay lit longer on clients than the host.
 Fixed other misc multiplayer visual bugs.
